keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 1.72 M km2: the Kirghiz ASSR created 26 August 1920 inside the RSFSR. The pages give no list of its guberniyas or oblasts; the shape is Kazakhstan without the lands of the Turkestan ASSR (created April 1918 and dissolved 27 October 1924). Cliopatria draws the lands inside Russian Republic/Republics of the Soviet Union shapes.

New keyframe, 2.31 M km2: the Kazak ASSR (renamed April or June 1925) drawn as all of Kazakhstan. None of the five pages opened dates the transfer of the Syr Darya and Semirechye lands to it after the Turkestan ASSR was split on 27 October 1924, so the southern lands are added at confidence 1. The Karakalpak Autonomous Oblast (1925, ASSR 20 March 1932, to the Uzbek SSR 5 December 1936) is not drawn: no page places it inside this republic.

New keyframe, 2.31 M km2 against the infobox 2,717,300 km2 (no year; ratio 1.18): Union republic from 5 December 1936 in the borders of today's Kazakhstan. The page lists no border change between 1936 and 1991.

region.text: the southern Kazakh lands of the Turkestan ASSR

ledger.note: 1924, October: the Syr Darya and Semirechye lands of the Turkestan ASSR (dissolved 27 October 1924) pass to the Kirghiz ASSR. Bridging: the Turkestan ASSR page lists the Uzbek SSR, Turkmen SSR, Tajik ASSR, Kara-Kirghiz AO and Karakalpak AO as the dissolution's successors and says nothing of Kazakh lands; the date and region are the researcher's reading from the Kazakh SSR's later borders.
1925, 15-19 April: the Kirghiz ASSR is renamed the Kazak ASSR (the Kazak ASSR page gives 15-19 June 1925 for the Fifth Kazakh Council of Soviets).
1929: Alma-Ata is designated the new capital in place of Kzyl-Orda (the page: "in 1927 or 1929. Sources differ").
1936, 5 December: the Kazak ASSR is detached from the RSFSR and becomes the Kazakh Soviet Socialist Republic, a union republic of the USSR.

region.text: the Kazak ASSR leaves the RSFSR as a union republic

ledger.note: 1936, 5 December: "on 5 December 1936 it was elevated to the status of a Union-level republic" (the RSFSR page gives 3 December). [Reviewer eu-17-x: mirror of the RSFSR dossier's vassal_end.]
1991, 10 December: the Kazakh SSR is renamed the Republic of Kazakhstan; it had declared sovereignty on 25 October 1990.
1991, 16 December: Kazakhstan declares independence, "the last republic to secede from the USSR"; the Soviet Union ends 26 December.

certainty.note: Steppe and desert frontiers; the Turkestan boundary of 1920-1924 and the southern lands are readings.
Union-republic borders of 1936; the Baikonur lease area is the exception.

notes: No Cliopatria row; the land is drawn inside Russian Republic/Republics of the Soviet Union/USSR shapes (and Kazakhstan from 1992). The pages are thin on territory: no page lists the Kirghiz ASSR's guberniyas, dates the Syr Darya and Semirechye transfers, or places the Karakalpak AO. The 1920-1924 shape is Kazakhstan minus the Turkestan ASSR dossier's lands (a reading shared with the alash-autonomy dossier, whose page was not opened in this run). Date of rename: 15-19 April 1925 on the SSR page, 15-19 June 1925 on the ASSR page (the two disagree). Capital: the pages do not say Orenburg was the first capital (other sources do); not entered. The RSFSR dossier records the Kirghiz/Kazak ASSR as a vassal tint from 26 August 1920 to 3 December 1936. Baikonur Cosmodrome (built in the 1950s) is inside the republic and later leased to Russia; no page opened gives dates. Counterparts: turkestan-assr exists; alash-autonomy exists.
